 Cleveland Cavaliers 90 – 82 Live 2' Philadelphia 76ers Live Updated a few seconds ago Cavs vs 76ers LIVE Updates, Last quarter begins (90-82)
 The players stepped onto the court and the ball flew for the Cavs vs 76ers
 Coverage by Victor Cunha Updated October 22, 2026, 9:48 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 Live Last update 9:48 PM ET 2' 9:48 PM ET a few seconds ago Six points lead
 Peyton Watson added two points, with three from James Harden in the sequence, in addition to two from Joel Embiid. We went through another moment of few points, to put the score at 106 to 100, with the 76ers still ahead!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 Key moments
 9:13 PM ET Last Quarter Begins 
 8:37 PM ET THIRD QUARTER BEGINS 
 8:26 PM ET HALFTIME 
 7:47 PM ET 2nd Q Starts 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 4' 9:40 PM ET 8 minutes ago Nine points lead
 Jaylen Brown added two points, with two more to follow. Tyrese Maxey added two points, at a time when there were few points in the game, to put the score at 104-95 for the 76ers at that time, with a nine-point lead.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 6' 9:35 PM ET 13 minutes ago 76ers leading
 Joel Embiid scored two points, with two more to follow. Jaylen Brown added two points on the next play and puts the 76ers ahead on the scoreboard, now beating the Cavaliers 98-95 in the game, with a three-point lead!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 8' 9:29 PM ET 19 minutes ago Three points lead
 LeBron James scored two points in two free throws, with James Harden adding three points, followed by two points from Joel Embiid, with another on a foul, bringing the lead to just three points, with the score at 95-92 for the Cavs.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 10' 9:24 PM ET 24 minutes ago Five points lead
 Tyrese Maxey added two points, along with two from Mario Hezonja and three from Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, to bring the score to 92-87, with the Cavs maintaining their lead by five points, in a short lead.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 9:13 PM ET 35 minutes ago Last Quarter Begins
 Martio Hezonja added two points, with two from Donovan Mitchell, in addition to two from Mario Hezonja, in a low-point end to the quarter, to close the score and open the final quarter with the score currently at 90 to 82 for the Cavs!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 2' 9:13 PM ET 35 minutes ago Two points lead
 LeBron James scored two points on two free throws, with two more from Jaylon Tyson, followed by one on two free throws from LeBron James, plus two from Donovan Mitchell, with two points on three free throws from Anfernee Simons, plus two from Tyrese Maxey, putting the score at 84-82!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 4' 9:00 PM ET an hour ago Five points lead
 Tyrese Maxey scored two points on the free throw, followed by three more. Tyrese Maxey added two points from two free throws to bring the score to 80-75, with the Cavaliers' lead from the first two quarters dwindling to five points!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 6' 8:52 PM ET an hour ago 12 points lead
 Joel Embiid scored two points, both from free throws, along with Jaylen Brown. Evan Mobley added two points, with another on a foul. LeBron James scored two points during a low-scoring period in the game, bringing the score to 80-68!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 8' 8:50 PM ET an hour ago 13 points lead
 Donovan Mitchell added two points, in addition to two from Joel Embiid, in addition to two from Jaylen Brown, followed by two from Donovan Mitchell, in addition to two from LeBron James, taking the advantage to 13 points at the moment, with the score at 75 to 62 for the Cavs.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 10' 8:50 PM ET an hour ago Start with points
 Jaylen Brown added three points, with VJ Edgecombe adding two, plus another free kick. LeBron James scored two points, with one more on the free kick. Joel Embiid added two points, with two from Peyton Watson, to make the score 71-56!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 8:37 PM ET an hour ago THIRD QUARTER BEGINS
 The players returned to the court and the ball flew into the third quarter of the game between the Cleveland Cavaliers and the Philadelphia 76ers, in the NBA regular season matchup, with all the plays and excitement here on VAVEL!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 8:26 PM ET an hour ago HALFTIME
 Donovan Mitchell scored three points, with Tyrese Maxey adding one more on two, followed by two points from Donovan Mitchell, two from VJ Edgecombe, and three from Joel Embiid, to close the score at 69-45 for the Cavaliers over the 76ers!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 2' 8:23 PM ET an hour ago Extending the lead
 Jarrett Allen scored two points, with two more from Tyrese Maxey, followed by two from Jarrett Allen, three from VJ Edgecombe, one on two from Tyrese Maxey, and two from Donovan Mitchell, bringing the score to 64-39!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 4' 8:10 PM ET 2 hours ago 25 points lead
 LeBron James added two points on the dunk, with two from Jarrett Allen, as well as one point from two free throws from VJ Edgecombe and two from two free throws from Jarrett Allen, to put the score at the moment at 58-33 on the scoreboard!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 6' 8:07 PM ET 2 hours ago 24 points lead
 Evan Mobley added three points, with Joel Embiid adding two points on two free throws, as well as two points on two free throws from Peyton Watson, to make the score 54-30 for the Cavaliers on the scoreboard.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 8' 8:04 PM ET 2 hours ago 21 points lead
 Sam Merrill scored two points, along with two from Jaylen Brown and two from Evan Mobley. Donovan Mitchell added one point from two free throws, along with two from Joel Embiid and two from Donovan Mitchell. Jabari Walker scored two points from shooting, along with two from Evan Mobley, bringing the score to 49-28!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 10' 8:01 PM ET 2 hours ago Start with points
 Evan Mobley scored two points from two free throws, followed by two more, plus two from Tyrese Maxey. Jaylon Tyson scored one point from two free throws, followed by two points from Tyrese Maxey, bringing the score to 40-22!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 7:47 PM ET 2 hours ago 2nd Q Starts
 Donovan Mitchell scored two points, followed by two from Mario Hezonja, and two from Jaylen Brown. Donovan Mitchell scored two points, putting the score at 35-18 for the Cavs over the 76ers, thus opening the second quarter!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 2' 7:41 PM ET 2 hours ago Still in 12 points lead
 Adem Bona scored two points, with two more from Mario Hezonja and three from Tyrese Maxey at this point in the game, followed by three points from Donovan Mitchell on three free throws, bringing the current score to 28-16!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 4' 7:34 PM ET 2 hours ago 12 points lead
 James Harden scored two points, with three more from Sam Merrill, followed by two from Evan Mobley, and three from James Harden, to bring the score to 23-11 for the Cavaliers, who are starting to extend their lead, now 12 points ahead.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 6' 7:28 PM ET 2 hours ago Cavs leading
 Jarrett Allen scored two points, with two more from Tyrese Maxey, plus two from Donovan Mitchell. Tyrese Maxey then added two more points, along with two from Evan Mobley, bringing the score to 13-11 for the Cavaliers.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 8' 7:26 PM ET 2 hours ago Tied
 VJ Edgecombe added two points, with one point off two free throws by James Harden, plus two from Joel Embiid, tying the game at 7-7 for the moment! The Cavaliers started scoring, but the 76ers quickly got back into the game!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 10' 7:25 PM ET 2 hours ago Start with points
 Jarrett Allen added two points, with two from Donovan Mitchell on two free throws. LeBron James added three points from the shot, with Jarrett Allen adding two points later, putting the score at 6-3 for the Cavaliers.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 7:15 PM ET 3 hours ago HERE WE GO
 The players stepped onto the court and the ball flew for the Cavs vs 76ers showdown in this first quarter of the NBA regular season game, with all the plays and excitement of the duel here on VAVEL! And, after the start, the first possession belongs to the Cavs!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 7:13 PM ET 3 hours ago Starting five
 And here are the starting five for today's game! For the Philadelphia 76ers, the lineup is: Tyrese Maxey, CJ Edgecombe, Jaylen Brown, LeBron James, and Joel Embiid. For the Cleveland Cavaliers, the lineup is: James Harden, Donovan Mitchell, Peyton Watson, Evan Mobley, and Jarrett Allen.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 7:09 PM ET 3 hours ago Tomorrow's games
 Today, in addition to the game later today, we will have one more match only: Thunder vs Nuggets. On Friday (23) many games take place: Bucks vs Bulls, Hornets vs Hawks, Celtics vs Knicks, Pacers vs Mavericks, Wizards vs Raptors, Magic vs Timberwolves, Heat vs Pistons, Spurs vs Rockets, Jazz vs Pelicans, Lakers vs Clippers, Kings vs Trail Blazers and Warriors vs Grizzlies.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 6:51 PM ET 3 hours ago Yesterday's games
 Yesterday more games took place, with the following results: Wizards 128-116 Bucks, Magic 125-132 Hawks, Heat 106-131 Timberwolves, Nets 103-110 Hornets, Raptors 135-92 Bulls, Pelicans 120-123 Pacers, Grizzlies 123-103 Jazz, Rockets 128-110 Mavericks, Lakers 127-105 Warriors, Trail Blazers 124-83 and Clippers 121-96 Kings.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 6:46 PM ET 3 hours ago Tuesday's games
 On Tuesday (20) the NBA regular season began, where the Detroit Pistons beat the Boston Celtics 121-113, the Philadelphia 76ers beat the New York Knicks 106-100 and the Oklahoma City Thunder beat the San Antonio Spurs 116-104.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 6:43 PM ET 3 hours ago Good evening!
 We're kicking off the broadcast of the game, with all the plays and excitement of the duel between the Cleveland Cavaliers and the Philadelphia 76ers in this NBA regular season, taking place at the Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia, on Thursday of the 2026-27 season!
